bead.title: Close hybrid-async hot-path gap to <=1.20x inmemory
bead.description:
PROBLEM: At 10k resident the objectlog/hybrid-async hot path is 2.836x inmemory for ack p99 and 33.359x for claim/finalize p95 (smoke is still 1.610x claim/finalize), far above the <=1.20x release gate, so the 10M release lane is blocked (docs/perf/evidence/performance_object_log_hybrid_release_10m.blocker.log).
ROOT CAUSE: hybrid-async is supposed to declare success after object-log manifest commit plus synchronous in-memory apply while SQLite projection apply lags, but the claim/finalize hot path currently blocks on the durable SQLite projection apply / group-commit fsync instead of returning after the memory apply. The durable projection apply is the WAL/synchronous group-commit path at crates/pqueue-sqlite/src/relational.rs:4344; the composed flush cadence is crates/pqueue-objectlog/src/segmented.rs:703 and commit_locked at crates/pqueue-objectlog/src/lib.rs:403; the measured hot-path loop is exercise_profile at crates/pqueue-server/tests/performance_object_log_hybrid_tests.rs:227.
PROPOSED FIX: make claim/finalize/ack return once the object-log manifest is committed and the in-memory ProjectionImage is applied, deferring SQLite projection apply to the async batch; serve readers/claims/metrics from memory while SQLite lags; preserve exactly-once async apply/replay after a partial-batch restart. Bring hybrid_ack_p99_vs_inmemory_ratio and hybrid_claim_finalize_p95_vs_inmemory_ratio to <=1.20 at the smoke and 10k cells.
NON-SCOPE: harness/scale/distribution work and gate/attribution work (other children); running the full 10M release matrix and emitting final docs (child 'Emit release-grade hybrid-async evidence'); release version bump.
GATE SUBSTITUTION: `cargo test -p pqueue-server` (and `cargo test --workspace` for regression) is the test gate; `cargo fmt --check` is the pre-commit gate.
bead.acceptance:
1. performance_object_log_hybrid_smoke reports hybrid_ack_p99_vs_inmemory_ratio<=1.20 AND hybrid_claim_finalize_p95_vs_inmemory_ratio<=1.20 with bars_met true: `PQUEUE_LEDGER_DIR=docs/perf/evidence cargo test -p pqueue-server --release --test performance_object_log_hybrid_tests performance_object_log_hybrid_smoke -- --nocapture`.
2. performance_object_log_hybrid_release_10m at PQUEUE_HYBRID_RESIDENT=10000 into docs/perf/evidence/hybrid-scale asserts bars_met (both ratios <=1.20): `PQUEUE_LEDGER_DIR=docs/perf/evidence/hybrid-scale PQUEUE_PERF_ENV=1 PQUEUE_HYBRID_RESIDENT=10000 cargo test -p pqueue-server --release --test performance_object_log_hybrid_tests performance_object_log_hybrid_release_10m -- --ignored --nocapture`.
3. New Test performance_object_log_hybrid_async_apply_exactly_once asserts memory-served claim/metrics while SQLite lags and exactly-once async apply after a partial-batch restart: `cargo test -p pqueue-server --release --test performance_object_log_hybrid_tests performance_object_log_hybrid_async_apply_exactly_once -- --nocapture`.
4. No regression in the objectlog/inmemory or objectlog/sqlite baselines produced in the same run: `cargo test --workspace` passes.
5. `cargo fmt --check` passes.
